## Qwen 3 Coder 480B Turbo API

Qwen 3 Coder 480B Turbo is a large language model by Alibaba Qwen, available on the Venice API as `qwen3-coder-480b-a35b-instruct-turbo`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Turbo variant of Qwen3 Coder 480B, optimized for faster inference on code tasks.

### Qwen 3 Coder 480B Turbo API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen3-coder-480b-a35b-instruct-turbo` | Standard | Private | $0.35 / $1.50 per 1M |

### Qwen 3 Coder 480B Turbo specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Alibaba Qwen |
| Released | Jan 27, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Context window | 256K tokens |
| Max output | 64K tokens |
| Served precision | FP8 |

### How to use the Qwen 3 Coder 480B Turbo API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "qwen3-coder-480b-a35b-instruct-turbo"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "qwen3-coder-480b-a35b-instruct-turbo",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
